title: PlacementParameterSet
description: The placement ceiling's declared, versioned input to the floor for one kind (item S4): which ranking method, its factor weights, and how many carriers may move per event. Scope-free, so a built-in set has one CID everywhere and ships with the floor (E1); where a set is in force is the head's fact (objects/placement-parameter-head). Its CID (`ParameterSet::cid`) is the atom CID of the canonical DAG-CBOR encoding over all five fields; its incumbency key (`ranking_cid`) is over kind, method and weights only, so republishing a set at another reach or move cap does not reset incumbency (E5). A tuning may only reweight: same kind and method, the same weight keys, each a factor the method reads, each weight at least 1, and a move cap inside the charter's range (`within_band`, E2, E6). No parameter set can make an ineligible carrier eligible: eligibility takes no parameters (§D.4). Wire shape: this schema is the source of record; placement_core::ParameterSet (elohim/placement/core/src/params.rs; serde camelCase, deny_unknown_fields) is its Rust mirror, not yet pinned to it by a test (follow-on: a placement-core schema_contract case that validates a serialized ParameterSet here). The Rust codec is the authority only for the canonical DAG-CBOR bytes and the CIDs (`ParameterSet::cid`, `ranking_cid`). Source of truth: the declarer's record, or the floor's own constant for a built-in set. Category A2 when published: a household-local record below public reach (R2) and an EPR head declaration's referent at collective or commons reach; no new DHT entry type. A built-in set is a constant of the floor, never published.

schema.description: The version of this struct's canonical encoding: 1 for the fields below, bumped only when a field is added, removed or reinterpreted. Not a protocol version. Part of `cid()`, not of `ranking_cid()`. A floor refuses a value it does not know as ParamRefusal::Unverifiable { input: "schema" }; this schema file shapes version 1 only.

method.description: The ranking method's id (MethodId): a CIDv1 with the raw codec (0x55) over sha2-256 of the UTF-8 method name `<namespace>:<area>:<name>@<version>`, e.g. elohim:placement:xor-distance@1; the `elohim` namespace is reserved for built-ins, and a method whose behaviour changes takes a new version and so a new id. Raw codec, so the string begins `bafkrei`.

weights.description: Factor weights in integer basis points (no floats, rail R-P3), each at least 1 (E6). Only factors the method reads may appear; a method that reads none (xor-distance) carries an empty object.

maxMovesPerEvent.description: Make-before-break cap: at most this many carrier moves per event (concern C6a), inside the charter's declared range.
